Name: Giant Crop Texture Modification
Author: RUBBERBARK
Description:
This mod has modified the appearance of the giant crop in SDV. Cauliflower now have larger flower parts and less leaves ; Melons now have leaves and stems that resemble real melons more, and have become slightly smoother; Pumpkins now look more like regular pumpkins, with slightly brighter colors. The powdermelons may be a bit too bright, adding a little shadow to them and changing their leaves.Modified Qi fruit expression and leaves.
Hope you have fun!
